description: Krwotok, a living gush of dark red blood, a lunging creature shaped from a thick swirling stream of glossy dark crimson blood, two pale glowing eyes, long dripping clawed arms of blood reaching forward, red droplets flying off, an abstract eerie creature, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
